note: FlyingThings3D_subset rate probe: same code path, truncated; NOT a pretrain

config.arm: Stage-1 recipe mirrored line-for-line; ONLY the dataset is the FlyingThings3D_subset corpus (|d| sign fix) instead of TRAIN A+C; loss mask gt>0 and gt<184 (P2A's ceiling, same formula).

intervention.window: w = round(512/s), h = round(256/s), uniform top-left
intervention.disparity_scaling: d[d>0] *= sx with sx = 512/w (realised, not sampled s)
intervention.op_order: crop -> resize -> ImageNet normalise -> gain jitter (P2A order)

config.dataset: flyingthings3d_subset TRAIN (official subset slice, NOT Stage-1 TRAIN A+C)
config.split: manifest-driven train / pretrain-val holdout (fixed random 5%, rng seed 0); pretrain monitoring ONLY
config.split_enforcement: train split only enters the optimizer loop; holdout is forward-only
config.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < 184
config.augmentation: scale-augmented random crop (the intervention), independent per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1; no horizontal flip
config.known_deviation: no batch normalisation (BN-folded exported artifact), carried into all arms
config.forbidden: no fine-tuning, no KITTI training, no hailo_val evaluation in E4 pretrain
